# src/ — implementation

## Purpose

Stateless zero-dependency Rust CLI (`wtf`) implemented purely on `std`.

## Ownership

- `lib.rs` — module registry (`config`, `fleet`, `json`, `probe`, `rand`, `util`) and `VERSION`.
- `config.rs` — `$WTF_HOME` resolution, atomic `0600` JSON persistence (`load_json`, `save_json`), and `valid_name` (blocks leading `-` and non-identifier characters).
- `fleet.rs` — keyless `FleetStore` (`Goal` and `SshAlias` CRUD in `fleet.json`), `valid_host`, PATH-based allowlisted tool probe (`probe_skills`), and `forbidden_keys`.
- `probe.rs` — bounded-timeout subprocess runner (`run_with_timeout`), local inspection (`probe_local`: hostname, OS/arch, allowlisted tools, `git status --porcelain=v1 -b`, `herdr agent list`), and parallel `BatchMode=yes` SSH probes (`build_ssh_argv`, `probe_remote`, `probe_all_remotes`).
- `json.rs` — depth-limited RFC 8259 JSON parser and serializer.
- `rand.rs` — kernel CSPRNG (`/dev/urandom` on Unix, `BCryptGenRandom` on Windows).
- `util.rs` — hex codec, epoch timestamps, UTF-8 char-boundary clamping, and `test_env_lock`.
- `main.rs` — CLI entrypoint (`status`, `pickup`, `goal`, `alias`, `skill`, `version`, `help`) embedding `../skill/wtf-is-going-on-mcp.md`.

## Local Contracts

- `[dependencies]` in `Cargo.toml` stays empty.
- Never invoke a shell (`sh -c` / `cmd /C`) for `ssh`, `git`, or tool probes; build explicit argv arrays and enforce wall-clock timeouts.
- Keep `fleet.json` and CLI JSON outputs free of keys/paths (`forbidden_keys` must remain empty).

## Verification

- `cargo test` — unit tests + `tests/cli.rs` integration suite.
- `cargo build --release` — LTO release build succeeds cleanly without warnings.
